help-accessibilityBody: Menus support keyboard navigation, visible focus and readable text. Charts offer tables. Reduced motion and independent sound levels are available. The actual aim drills require visual perception and pointer movement; they are not claimed to support every visual or motor access need. Target palettes affecting difficulty are part of the comparison key.
help-browserBody: Use a modern desktop browser with WebGL2 and pointer lock for 3D. If unavailable, all 2D modes remain an alternative. Mouse deltas use degrees per count and are not multiplied by frame time. FOV is vertical degrees. Raw-input requests can fall back to ordinary pointer lock. Displayed FPS is measured rendering performance, not input latency. Only one tab may train at once. The app pauses on hidden tabs, lost focus, pointer release, context loss or long frame gaps.
help-comparisonsBody: Personal records require completed, uninterrupted standard or daily runs with matching scenario version, scoring version, input, geometry, duration, FOV, palette and smoothing. Practice and custom runs are saved separately. Sensitivity is recorded for analysis. Goals are versioned application defaults, not professional ranks. No global rankings or verified competition are provided.
help-controlsBody: 2D: move the pointer and press the primary button to hit circles. Tracking: hold the button while following the target. Reaction: wait for the visible cue before pressing. 3D: Start requests pointer capture; mouse movement turns the camera. Escape releases control and pauses. Only arena input counts. Touch is supported in 2D and has separate records.
help-metricsBody: Click accuracy = 100 × hits / shots. Click score = max(0, 100 × hits − 25 × misses). Hits per second = hits / active seconds. Tracking = 100 × time on target while firing / all target exposure; tracking score = round(10 × tracking percent). Reaction score = max(0, 1000 − median reaction ms − 100 × false starts − 100 × timeouts). Acquisition is time from target spawn to hit; reaction is cue-to-input. Median and p90 use up to the first 256 observations, not averages of session medians. Empty denominators show —. Center error is measured in target-radius units, separately by dimension.
help-offlineBody: From Settings, prepare both engines while connected. The complete static app is cached only after preparation succeeds. Install the app using the browser’s install action where supported. Updates wait until you choose Install update and reload between rounds; there is no automatic mid-round reload.
help-privacyBody: All progress is stored in localStorage on this browser and origin. No account, backend, telemetry, advertising, external fonts or cloud synchronization is used. Local data is not encrypted and is editable. Private browsing or clearing browser data can remove it. Export JSON for backup; import validates before a confirmed replacement and keeps a recovery copy. Sharing only occurs when you choose it.
help-retentionBody: Retain up to 500 sessions and 20 heatmaps, 24 months of daily summaries, and 60 months of monthly summaries. Older all-time totals and personal records remain where space permits. A 3 MiB soft budget includes recovery overhead. Compaction moves each result into an aggregate exactly once. Export cannot restore details already compacted. Storage errors never display a false Saved message; export unsaved results before leaving.
help-streaksBody: Training-day streak: consecutive local dates meeting the frozen daily goal, initially three completed minutes. An unfinished today does not erase yesterday’s streak. Challenge win streak: consecutive eligible standard wins; failed or abandoned timed attempts reset it. Practice and daily runs do not change it. Hit combo: consecutive hits within one run; misses and 2D target expiration break it. Sessions belong to their start date, even across midnight.
